svg.title: Message cleanup and tidy-specific tags
svg.desc: Message cleanup and tidy tags move into finalizeDiagnostic(), after notes and fixes are assembled. Constructor errors get tidy metadata here because they precede check initialization. Cleanup still covers messages, notes and fixes; containment checks avoid duplicate tags. Message cleanup covers the diagnostic, its notes and fixes. Fallback names handle constructor diagnostics; containment checks avoid duplicate tags.
svg.text: Message cleanup and tidy tags move into finalizeDiagnostic(), after notes and fixes are assembled. Constructor errors get tidy metadata here
because they precede check initialization. Cleanup still covers messages, notes and fixes; containment checks avoid duplicate tags.
// clang-tidy bakes the name into diagnostic messages. Strip it out.
// It would be much nicer to make clang-tidy not do this.
Message cleanup covers the diagnostic, its notes and fixes.
Fallback names handle constructor diagnostics; containment checks avoid duplicate tags.
